content.short: Trustware lets applications and institutions accept deposits from any blockchain.
content.description: Trustware lets dapps, institutions and end users accept deposits from any blockchain without building the routing themselves. Integrators drop in a widget that detects a Trustware wallet, connects an existing wallet or uses WalletConnect, and can run the same widget in swap mode. The SDK covers embedded wallets, withdrawals from them and deposits straight into vault destinations.
content.meta: Trustware lets applications and institutions accept blockchain deposits from any network.
